name: style
description: Shared style (asset, not drawn). Shapes that use it via "style" take from it the properties they do not set themselves. Changing the style changes all those shapes at once.
help: Shared style (an asset, not drawn). Shapes that use it take from it the appearance they do not set themselves.

fill.help: Fill color for the shapes that use this style.

fillGradient.help: Fill gradient; when set, it replaces fill.
